title: Claude Code PreToolUse hook output
description: JSON a PreToolUse hook prints on stdout (exit 0) to decide a pending tool call. Exit 0 with no output leaves the normal permission flow untouched; this schema describes a hook that returns an explicit decision.

hookEventName.description: Discriminator; must match the firing event.

permissionDecision.description: allow: skip the permission prompt. deny: block the call. ask: prompt the user. defer: exit gracefully so the call can resume later. Across stacked hooks the precedence is deny > defer > ask > allow.

permissionDecisionReason.description: For deny: shown to Claude. For allow/ask: shown to the user. For defer: ignored. Provide this whenever permissionDecision is deny.

updatedInput.description: Optional. Replaces the ENTIRE tool input object, so include unchanged fields too. Ignored when permissionDecision is defer.

additionalContext.description: Optional extra context delivered to Claude alongside the tool result. Ignored when permissionDecision is defer.

continue.description: If false, Claude stops processing entirely after the hook runs. Overrides any event-specific decision.

stopReason.description: Message shown to the user when 'continue' is false. Not shown to Claude.

suppressOutput.description: If true, hides the hook's stdout from the transcript.

systemMessage.description: Warning message shown to the user.

terminalSequence.description: Terminal escape sequence Claude Code emits for the hook (OSC 0/1/2/9/99/777 and BEL only; anything else is ignored). Requires Claude Code v2.1.141+.
